interpretations.text: Dürer's Saint Jerome in His Study shows the translator of the Vulgate at work in a calm, ordered room, with a skull on the windowsill as a quiet memento mori. Learning and death share the same space: scholarship is meaningful because life is finite. The lion at rest and the sleeping dog suggest tamed passions. It is an image of disciplined solitude— attention as a spiritual practice—and of wisdom that keeps mortality in view without panic.
Peaceful, luminous, focused. Warm daylight through circular windows. Ideal for themes of deep work, monastic focus, reading as devotion, and calm acceptance of time.
Interior perspective, strong orthogonals, Jerome writing at a slanted desk, skull near window, lion in foreground, rich engraving detail of wood and light.
